name: Cellarhand domain icons
license: Original work created for Cellarhand. No third-party assets. Free to use, modify and redistribute within this product.
rules: Icons reinforce a visible text label and never replace one.
Stroke width does not scale with the icon; it stays 1.6 at a 24 viewBox.
Icons carry no colour of their own; they inherit currentColor.
Reserved for the twelve domain destinations and for act types in a timeline or lineage.
Never on buttons, form labels, section headings or ordinary list rows.
aria-hidden="true" when beside a text label; aria-label required when genuinely alone.

icons.metaphor: A ruled order sheet with the last line ticked
icons.note: Matches the printed sheet still clipped to the tank.

icons.metaphor: A tank with a level line
icons.note: The level line is the point: a vessel is defined by how full it is.

icons.metaphor: Three trellis posts on a row line
A picking bin being filled from above
icons.note: Least universal of the set; a new worker may need the label once. It always carries one.

icons.metaphor: An open-top vessel with CO2 rising
icons.note: Deliberately the cellar icon minus its lid — same object, active state.

icons.metaphor: Two streams joining and flowing down
icons.note: Reversed, it is the split marker in the lineage view.

icons.metaphor: A divided case with top handles
icons.note: The case, not the bottle — packaging is counted in cases, and a bottle outline turns to mush at 20px.

icons.metaphor: A stacked pallet, two and one
icons.note: No dividers, and a group of objects — distinguishes it from bottling.

icons.metaphor: A filed form with a struck seal
icons.note: The seal separates it from a work order: filed with a government, not clipped to a tank.

icons.metaphor: Two unequal columns between double rules
icons.note: A ledger balance, not a bar chart. Reports use no icon.
Directional, so it cannot be confused with static inventory.

icons.metaphor: Two set values on two tracks
icons.note: The one deliberately generic icon. Setup is genuinely a software concept; a winery metaphor here would be decoration.

icons.metaphor: A volume seen in three dimensions
icons.note: A lot is neither a place nor a container: it is a quantity of wine with an identity.

icons.metaphor: A banded portable keg with a handle
icons.note: Added with RFC-002. Distinct from the cellar tank by its bands and handle.
Utility icon, not a domain icon. Permitted inside the search field and on the Find tab.

icons.metaphor: Framing corners with a read line
icons.note: Utility icon. Always paired with the word Scan.
